dg-note-properties.world-date: Week 3 after the seal broke · Early summer · The passes are open
headlines: **The ward broke.** The cave at the foot of Wardpeak stands open. Nobody who has properly gone in has properly come back.
**The king is dead** and Orlyn is half-burned and lawless. A warlord holds the road south.
**Goblin raids** are pushing down on the northern farmsteads, better supplied than goblins should be.
**Fellgard is safe,** for now. Overcrowded, undermanned, and the granary is thin.
rumours: The seal was never real. Something just finally woke up.
The fen-folk killed the king. Everyone in Orlyn says so.
Those goblins had new steel. Goblins don't forge steel.
The Vigil failed in its duty and now we all pay for it.
There is a second way into the mountain, if you can find the shepherd who used it.

Fellgard Holds.md.body: Sign up on Discord by the Wednesday.
